name: Poor Law Unions 1 Apr 1924
description: The 27 Poor Law Unions of Northern Ireland from 1 Apr 1924 until the boards of guardians' functions passed to the county welfare and health authorities on 5 Jul 1948; every board was abolished on 30 Sep 1948. Each union is the dissolution of its district electoral divisions on Civgraph's 1926 DED map (Paddy Matthews), placed in their unions by the 1926 Census Topographical Index. The only change from 1921 is the Ardkeen, Portaferry and Quintin area, moved from Downpatrick to Newtownards Union; the 1937 Census records no union changes in 1926-37, the district changes of 1937-48 each fell inside one union, and the Belfast Gazette to 1948 has no order altering a union. Each union carries its 1926 and 1937 census acreage and population; with the large loughs taken out the map areas agree with the census acreages to a median of 0.2%. After 1948 the unions remained as superintendent registrars' districts.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 105 (Downpatrick and Newtownards Unions)
references.note: 29 Jun 1923, pp. 300, 316-317. Ministry of Home Affairs orders of 16 Jun 1923: the townlands of the Ardkeen, Portaferry and Quintin electoral divisions separated from Downpatrick Union and added to Newtownards Union, in force 1 Apr 1924 (townland schedules printed).

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 144 (Superintendent Registrars' Districts of Downpatrick and Newtownards)
references.note: 28 Mar 1924, p. 678. Registrar-General's order of 18 Mar 1924 making the same change to the registration districts from 1 Apr 1924.

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1926: General Report
references.note: Administrative divisions pp. xvii-xviii (27 unions; change (r): part of Downpatrick RD and Union to Newtownards, 1 Apr 1924); Table 4, Poor Law Unions (areas and populations).

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1926: Topographical Index
references.note: Index 2 (unions by county), Index 3 (county districts with their union) and Index 7 (DEDs, with the union noted where it differs from the rural district).

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1937: Preliminary Report
references.note: Supplement to the 1926 index, p. 10: no changes to Poor Law Unions 1926-1937. Table 6, Poor-Law Unions (areas and populations, 1937).

references.label: Public Health and Local Government (Abolition of Boards of Guardians) Order (Northern Ireland) 1948 (S.R. & O. 1948 No. 187)
references.note: Made 5 Jul 1948 under ss. 8 and 28 of the Public Health and Local Government (Administrative Provisions) Act (NI) 1946. Remaining functions transferred on the appointed day, 5 Jul 1948; each board abolished on a date the Ministry fixed, no later than 31 Oct 1948.

references.note: Made 30 Sep 1948. Substitutes Article 7 of the 1948 order (No. 187): every board of guardians abolished on 30 Sep 1948. Notice in Belfast Gazette 1424, 8 Oct 1948.
